faqs.a:
(a)
The city reserves the right to hold special functions at the reservoir at any time
               and may close the reservoir to permit holders during such special functions.
(b)
No vehicle will exceed the speed of ten miles per hour while at the reservoir.
(c)
Any person who hikes or rides a bicycle at the reservoir will remain on designated
               and signed trails.
(d)
The Arvada/Blunn Reservoir property will be open from sunrise to sunset from April
               1 through October 31 to all permit holders, except when there is ice on the reservoir
               or because of administrative closures by the city.
(Code 1981, § 22-28; Ord. No. 2577, § 2, 12-19-1988; Ord. No. 2709, § 2, 3-5-1990;
               Ord. No. 2956, § 8, 2-15-1993; Ord. No. 3051, § 1, 3-4-1994)
